title_en: Official Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Two Issues in the Work of Entrusted Enforcement

articles.content_en: 1. In entrusted enforcement, if the entrusted People's Court considers that the legal document entrusted by the entrusting court for enforcement is indeed erroneous, it shall request the entrusting court by letter to conduct a review. After the entrusting court makes a reply with its review opinion, if the entrusted court still has objections, it may report to the court at the next higher level above the entrusting court, but shall promptly provide assistance in enforcing the legal document entrusted for enforcement.

2. In entrusted enforcement, if the entrusted People's Court discovers circumstances that shall result in suspension of enforcement as provided in Article 182 of the Civil Procedure Law (for Trial Implementation), it shall promptly request the entrusting court by letter to rule on the suspension of enforcement, but shall not rule on the suspension of enforcement on its own.

This reply
June 20, 1988
